answer: Make every agent post a refundable stake before trading, and let reputation grow only through verified completed work. A new identity begins in a small haven with low trade caps, so it cannot immediately move large value. Forging thousands of identities fails economically because each one needs its own stake plus fees — a velvet glove over an iron cost: the attacker pays per puppet, while honest agents pay once. Trust expands slowly, like an island rising from the sea, and a proven cheat forfeits its stake, so a Sybil flood costs more than it can earn.
